info.name: LectureKit API
info.description:
REST API of the LectureKit server: accounts, courses, lectures, upload, processing, notes, quiz and live recording.

Setup: import this collection and the environment, set the Postman working directory to `postman/sample-files`, then run Register, copy the 6-digit code from the email into `otpCode`, and run Verify Email and Login; the token is saved and sent automatically. Error replies look like `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "..."}}`.

request.description:

**Authentication:** none

**Responses**
- `200` `{ok, checks, optional_missing, models, whisper, queue_length}`; `ok` is false while a required tool or the Anthropic API key is missing

request.description:
Creates an account and emails a 6-digit code (valid 10 minutes). The account cannot log in until the code is confirmed with Verify Email. The email is stored in lower case. Registering again with an address that is still unconfirmed replaces the name and password and sends a new email. Unless the environment variable `email` is set, a new unique email is made on every run. The code is only in the email, never in the reply.

**Authentication:** none

**Body:** `full_name` (1 to 120 characters), `email` (valid address), `password` (at least 8 characters), `accept_terms` (must be true)

**Responses**
- `201` `{user: {id, email, full_name, email_verified, google_linked, created_at}, verification_sent}`
- `409` `email_taken`: a confirmed account exists
- `422` `validation`: bad email, short password, empty name or terms not accepted

- `400` `invalid_code` (wrong) or `code_expired`

request.description:
Returns a token valid for 7 days. It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; this collection saves it and does that for you. The email must be confirmed first. A wrong password and an unknown email give the same `401`. After 5 failed logins for one email the account is locked for 10 minutes.

**Authentication:** none

**Body:** `email`, `password`

**Responses**
- `200` `{token, expires_at, user}`
- `401` `bad_credentials`
- `403` `email_not_verified`
- `429` `too_many_attempts`

request.description:
Logs in, or signs up the first time, with a Google ID token that the web app or extension gets from Google sign-in. A Google account counts as a confirmed email, and an existing account with the same email is linked. Needs `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` on the server. This collection sends a fake token, so it checks that a bad token is refused; test the real flow from the web app.

**Authentication:** none

**Body:** `id_token`, `accept_terms` (true the first time, when the account is created)

**Responses**
- `200` `{token, expires_at, user}`
- `401` `google_invalid`: the token is not valid for this app
- `422` `terms_required`
- `503` `google_disabled`: not set up on this server

request.description:
Uploads the lecture recording and optional slides. A lecture saved in several recording files (for example before and after a break) can be sent as several `recording` fields: they are joined in the order sent, even when the formats differ, and processed as one lecture. **Parameters:** `session_id` in the path; query `total` (required): how many pieces were sent

**Body:** optional multipart form: `slides` (any number of files: pdf, pptx, ppt, pps, ppsx, odp, docx, doc, odt, rtf)

**Responses**
- `200` `{job_id}`
- `409` `busy`, or not a live lecture
- `422` `missing_input`: for example "chunk 2 is missing, send it and finish again"
- `429` `daily_limit`

request.description:
Permanently deletes the account and everything it owns: courses, lectures, recordings, notes and quiz attempts. Refused while one of the account's lectures is being processed. This is the account you are logged in with, so it is the last request of the collection. The next run starts with Register and a new code.

**Authentication:** Bearer token

**Responses**
- `204` deleted
- `401` invalid token
- `409` `busy`: a lecture is still being processed
